The Alameda County Democratic Party urges Democratic candidates to refuse contributions and endorsements from police officer unions. Please list below all such contributions or endorsements you have received since 2018 or indicate that none has been received. For each contribution received, indicate whether you intend to retain the funds, return them, or donate them to organizations in Alameda County advancing racial justice. Contributions and endorsements from police officer unions DO NOT automatically disqualify you from endorsement consideration.

The Alameda County Democratic Party urges Democratic candidates to refuse contributions and endorsements from fossil fuel entities as defined by: fossil fuel corporations; California-based investor-owned utilities; and fossil fuel industry executives, lobbyists, and political action committees (see www.NoFossilFuelMoney.org). Please list below all such contributions or endorsements you have received since 2018 or indicate that none has been received. Alameda County Democratic Party — Candidate Questionnaire, General 2026. Pulled from the form's own data payload, so wording is verbatim.

DUE AUGUST 28, 2026 AT 12 P.M. for full consideration.

SCREENING INTERVIEW REQUIRED — schedule separately at calendly.com/acdems-info/interview. The questionnaire alone is not the whole process.

ELIGIBILITY. Endorsement goes only to registered Democrats, and the Party will not endorse more candidates for an office than there are seats to fill. This form is only for Alameda County races on the November 2026 ballot, not state or federal races already considered by the California Democratic Party.

SIGNED UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY, and the application is available to any ACDCC member on request — the same central committee members held in the call list under Endorsement – ACD. Treat every answer as visible to the people who vote on it.

TWO MONEY QUESTIONS reach back to 2018 and ask what will be done with any funds received: police officer unions, and fossil fuel entities. Neither is automatically disqualifying.

READING THE CA DEM PLATFORM is a required checkbox, with space to note substantive disagreement.
